title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Friday, 25 September 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Germany news: Parliament to vote on fuel tax cut
highlights.summary: German lawmakers hope to drive down fuel prices by cutting taxes on gas and diesel from October 1. Meanwhile, students in many cities are set to protest against military conscription. DW has the latest.

highlights.headline: Interactive: What China’s dozens of ‘five-year plans’ say about climate and energy
highlights.summary: Almost three-quarters of the 72 five-year plans published by China this year include policies or targets related to climate change… The post Interactive: What China’s dozens of ‘five-year plans’ say about climate and energy appeared first on Carbon Brief.

highlights.headline: Nigeria, US agree to boost mining investment on sidelines of UN General Assembly
highlights.summary: On the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Nigeria and the US inked a new mining deal. Nigeria is home to deposits of lithium, gold, tin, gemstones, iron ore and phosphate.
